question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who collects stamps
solution:
The one word for the given group of words 'One who collects stamps' is **Philatelist.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• ​__We need to choose one word for the 'one who collects stamps'.
 
• Let us explore the **meanings of all options :**
 
 
• **Numismatist **is related to or consists of coins or medals.
 
• **Narcissist **is a person who has an excessive interest in or admiration of themselves.
 
• **Philatelist** is a person who studies or collects postage stamps.
 
• **Collector is** a person who collects things as a hobby or as part of his/her job.
 
 
 
• From the given meanings, it is clear that the **one word **for the given group of words* 'One who collects stamps'* is **Philatelist.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 3.**
